title: Read epic-head CI after each integration, not first at the review
description:
Twice in 43y the integrated per-tick gate stayed green while CI on epic/43y went red on a shorttest.EndToEnd test. enb: seven reconcile e2e fixtures still declared cloud runner pi after twa. 4w7: the classification pin was stale after 7sn's profile edit. Each red sat until a final review read CI hours later and absorbed it after the review, costing a review round each time. The run already reads CI on main and at the close-out. Reading the epic branch's CI for each integrated code commit, and absorbing a red as a finding at once, would catch the next one at the tick that caused it. 3sd is the narrow fix for one of the two shapes.
evidence: .tick/issues/66a.json and .tick/issues/o68.json notes (enb, 4w7 absorptions); CI runs 37380024533, 37378487207, 37376277849 (red, epic head)

ticfac run epic-43y filed this backlog tick from the finding aa99bb63ee11ebf1a366a801893c4d29674c0007228a8b828e7cfc2467c901a0 (reported by run-epic-43y/tick-j2k/attempt-69): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-43y/absorptions/aa99bb63ee11ebf1a366a801893c4d29674c0007228a8b828e7cfc2467c901a0.json on the run branch.
